information:
This competition only features FMC. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list), including [Texas Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2025).

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
